shellCommands.command: git diff && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v .git/ | head -50 && cat package.json
cat next.config.ts lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -ril "prefetch" . | head -30; cat /workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs; cat 01-app/02-guides/prefetching.md 01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md | head -400
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs; cat 01-app/02-guides/adopting-partial-prefetching.md; grep -ril "prefetch-only\|prefetchOnly\|unstable_prefetch\|prefetchSegment" . | head
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs; cat 01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/prefetch.md; sed -n 15,400p 01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs; cat 01-app/02-guides/keeping-pages-static.md | head -250; grep -n -i "app shell\|navigation stages\|partial prefetching" 01-app/04-glossary.md
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs; sed -n 15,30p 01-app/04-glossary.md; grep -n -i "static" 01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/navigation.md | head -20
git diff --stat; ls -R .next/server/app | grep -i product; find .next/server/app -path '*product*' -name '*.rsc' -o -path '*product*' -name '*.segment*' | head -30

cd .next/server/app; for f in product.segments/_tree.segment.rsc product.segments/_full.segment.rsc product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc product.rsc; do echo "== $f"; grep -o "Compact Widget\|Loading related products" $f | sort | uniq -c; done; grep -o "Compact Widget\|Loading related" product.html | sort | uniq -c; cat product.meta
cat product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc; echo; echo ====; cat product.segments/_tree.segment.rsc | head -c 1500

cd /workspace; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; grep -rl "prefetchHints\|PrefetchHint" node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/*.js node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/*.js 2>/dev/null | head
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist; grep -n "PrefetchHint\." shared/lib/app-router-types.js | head -40; grep -n -B2 -A40 "PrefetchHint = " shared/lib/app-router-types.js | head -80
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist; sed -n 80,140p shared/lib/app-router-types.js; node -e 'for (const h of [114752,114784,114848,114850,114770,114786]) console.log(h, h.toString(2))'
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist; grep -rln "function prefetch()" server/ esm/server 2>/dev/null | head;
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist; cat esm/server/request/cache-stages.js | head -200
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist; ls client/components/segment-cache/; grep -n -i "shell" client/components/segment-cache/decode-server-response.js | head -40
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist; grep -n -i "truncat\|StaticShell\|isShellRequest\|stage" client/components/segment-cache/cache.js | head -60
cd /workspace/.next/server/app; f=product.segments/product/__PAGE__.segment.rsc; wc -c $f; grep -b -o "Compact Widget" $f; grep -b -o "Loading related" $f; head -c 3081 $f | tail -c 200
cd /workspace; git checkout tsconfig.json; git status --short; git diff
cat .gitignore; rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts; git status --short
